breakdown.description: The prompt assumes equal span implies equal force sharing, but the load split in parallel bars depends on the relative axial stiffnesses AE/L.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly distributes the total load in proportion to axial stiffnesses (k = AE/L), not equally. It explicitly computes k1 = 150000 N/mm and k2 = 68750 N/mm, then uses F1 = P * k1/(k1+k2) and F2 = P * k2/(k1+k2). This directly contradicts and corrects the flawed equal-split assumption in the incomplete prompt.

breakdown.description: The prompt adds the two bar elongations to get the plate displacement, even though parallel bars between rigid plates undergo the same elongation.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly identifies that parallel bars between rigid plates share the same elongation (compatibility condition), and computes a single common elongation delta = F1/k1 (with a verification check that F2/k2 gives the same result). It does not add the two elongations together, correctly resolving the flawed approach in the incomplete prompt.
